title.en: A Dual Evaluation for Music Transcription
title.zh: A Dual Evaluation for Music Transcription

text.en: A dual evaluation of notation accuracy and playback fidelity across 24 transcription pipelines (eight audio-to-MIDI models × three MIDI-to-score converters) on 230 piano performances. Designed an IRB-exempt, reference-anchored ABX listening study over all 276 system pairs, with randomized A/B order and recruitment sized by a power analysis (106 participants, 3,180 judgments), aggregated with a Bradley–Terry model; CLEWS agreed best with listeners (Spearman ρ = 0.971) at the lowest cost.
text.zh: 在 230 段鋼琴演奏上，從樂譜正確性與播放擬真度雙重評估 24 種採譜流程（8 個音訊轉 MIDI 模型 × 3 個 MIDI 轉樂譜系統）。設計經 IRB 核定豁免、以參考錄音為錨點的 ABX 聽測，涵蓋全部 276 組系統配對，隨機化 A/B 順序，並以模擬檢定力分析決定招募人數（106 位受試者、3,180 筆判斷），再以 Bradley–Terry 模型彙整；CLEWS 與聽眾判斷最一致（Spearman ρ = 0.971），成本也最低。

text.en: Rubric rewards from pretrained audio-language models for text-to-music post-training: candidates for the same prompt are ranked by rubric score into preference pairs for DPO on MusicGen-small and ACE-Step v1, and the scores serve directly as rewards for online RL with DiffusionNFT on ACE-Step. Rubric rewards improve CLAP, SongEval, and Audiobox-Aesthetics together, while single-metric rewards cause trade-offs.
text.zh: 以預訓練音訊語言模型的評分標準（rubric）作為文字生成音樂的後訓練獎勵：同一提示詞產生的候選依 rubric 分數排序成偏好資料對，用於 MusicGen-small 與 ACE-Step v1 的 DPO；分數也直接作為 ACE-Step 上 DiffusionNFT 線上強化學習的獎勵。Rubric 獎勵能同時提升 CLAP、SongEval 與 Audiobox-Aesthetics，而只用單一指標當獎勵則會造成指標間的取捨。

org.en: Music and AI Lab, National Taiwan University
org.zh: 臺灣大學 Music and AI Lab

text.en: A bilingual (Mandarin/English), lyric-aligned audio-to-lead-sheet system that integrates pretrained models for separation, beat and downbeat tracking, structure, melody, chords, and lyric alignment. Against the original Sheet Sage, scored with the same code, it raises note F1@50 ms on GTSinger from 0.080 to 0.295 and chord WCSR on GuitarSet from 0.621 to 0.904. Accepted for presentation at ISMIR 2026 Late-Breaking/Demo.
text.zh: 雙語（中文／英文）、歌詞對齊的音訊轉主旋律譜系統，整合預訓練模型進行音源分離、拍點與強拍追蹤、段落結構、旋律、和弦與歌詞對齊。以相同程式碼評分，相較原版 Sheet Sage，GTSinger 上的音符 F1@50 ms 從 0.080 提升到 0.295，GuitarSet 上的和弦 WCSR 從 0.621 提升到 0.904。已獲 ISMIR 2026 Late-Breaking/Demo 接受發表。

title.en: Lyrics-to-Song Generation with MIDI-LLM and MIDI-SAG
title.zh: 以 MIDI-LLM 與 MIDI-SAG 進行歌詞生成歌曲

text.en: An end-to-end, lyrics-conditioned song generation pipeline that connects symbolic lead-sheet generation with arrangement and audio synthesis. Fine-tuning language models to generate melody, chords, rhythm, and lyric-aligned symbolic representations, including syllable-level lyric pointers, phonetic information, rests, breaths, and many-to-many lyric–note alignment for controllable generation.
text.zh: 端到端、以歌詞為條件的歌曲生成流程，串接符號主旋律譜生成、編曲與音訊合成。微調語言模型以生成旋律、和弦、節奏與歌詞對齊的符號表示，包含音節層級的歌詞指標、發音資訊、休止、換氣，以及多對多的歌詞與音符對齊，以實現可控生成。
